warrior.supplement.ironhide-graft.name: Ironhide Graft
warrior.supplement.ironhide-graft.effect: Gain +2 AC against melee attack rolls and reduce the first physical weapon damage you take each round by 1.

source.originalText: | Ironhide Graft | +2 AC vs melee, +1 DR |

warrior.supplement.bloodthick-node.name: Bloodthick Node
warrior.supplement.bloodthick-node.duration: While active during a real encounter
warrior.supplement.bloodthick-node.frequency: Once at start of each regular turn
warrior.supplement.bloodthick-node.effect: Regain HP equal to current BT, maximum 3 HP per turn or 4 with Stack Overflow. No healing occurs outside a real encounter and it removes no Wounds. Each HP actually restored spends 1 Mutation Recovery Reserve; heal no more than remaining reserve.

source.originalText: | Bloodthick Node | Heal 1 HP per BT stack each round |

warrior.supplement.spinal-buffer.name: Spinal Buffer
warrior.supplement.spinal-buffer.effect: Gain +1 on saving throws against being knocked Prone, Stunned or forcibly moved. If an effect uses an ability check rather than a save, add +1 to that check instead.

source.originalText: | Spinal Buffer | +1 Save vs knockback, stuns, and forced movement |

warrior.supplement.flesh-warden.name: Flesh Warden
warrior.supplement.flesh-warden.effect: Increase maximum HP by 2 per Warrior level while equipped. Equipping raises maximum only, never current HP. Unequipping clamps current HP to the reduced maximum if necessary; it does not subtract another amount from current HP. Repeated swaps cannot heal.

source.originalText: | Flesh Warden | +2 HP per level |

warrior.supplement.plated-shoulder.name: Plated Shoulder
warrior.supplement.plated-shoulder.effect: While adjacent to substantial terrain, a wall or a willing ally of your size or larger, you gain half cover against ranged attacks.

source.originalText: | Plated Shoulder | Gain half cover while standing adjacent to terrain or ally |

warrior.supplement.redundant-organs.name: Redundant Organs
warrior.supplement.redundant-organs.effect: When damage would reduce you to 0 HP without killing you outright, remain at 1 HP instead.

source.originalText: | Redundant Organs | First time you'd fall to 0 HP, stay at 1 (1/long rest) |

warrior.supplement.rapid-coagulation.name: Rapid Coagulation
warrior.supplement.rapid-coagulation.duration: While active during a real encounter
warrior.supplement.rapid-coagulation.effect: If you did not move during your previous turn, regain 2 HP at the start of your current turn. This does not function outside a real encounter. Each HP actually restored spends 1 Mutation Recovery Reserve; heal no more than remaining reserve.

source.originalText: | Rapid Coagulation | Gain Regeneration 2 if you haven't moved this round |

warrior.supplement.ossified-core.name: Ossified Core
warrior.supplement.ossified-core.effect: Critical hits against you do not add extra critical damage dice. Additionally reduce piercing damage you take by 2 after resistance.

source.originalText: | Ossified Core | Immune to crit damage; take 2 less damage from piercing attacks |

warrior.supplement.adrenal-floodgate.name: Adrenal Floodgate
warrior.supplement.adrenal-floodgate.effect: When you first fall to one-quarter maximum HP or less, regain 2d8 HP and end either Frightened, Poisoned or Staggered on yourself.

source.originalText: | Adrenal Floodgate | Once per encounter, heal 2d8 HP and remove 1 condition when you drop below 25% HP |

warrior.supplement.thickened-bone-weave.name: Thickened Bone Weave
warrior.supplement.thickened-bone-weave.duration: Until end of your next regular turn
warrior.supplement.thickened-bone-weave.effect: When you activate a serum or gain at least 1 BT, gain DR 2 against physical weapon damage until the end of your next regular turn. Reapplication refreshes but does not stack.

source.originalText: | Thickened Bone Weave | +2 DR for 2 rounds after using a serum or gaining a BT stack |

warrior.supplement.mythic-carapace.name: Mythic Carapace
warrior.supplement.mythic-carapace.duration: Until encounter ends, mutation ends or you fall below one-quarter maximum HP
warrior.supplement.mythic-carapace.effect: Gain DR 3 against all damage and immunity to Bleed, Poisoned and Burn-style ongoing fire effects. Once per encounter when one hit deals more than 20 actual damage after mitigation, gain 1 BT and refresh the remaining duration of your other active mutations to 3 rounds. It grants no serum-profile refresh.
warrior.supplement.mythic-carapace.prerequisite: Warrior 15; Apex Vital; maximum one Apex equipped

source.originalText:
| Mythic Carapace | While this is active:
- +3 DR flat
- Immune to Bleed, Poison, and Burn
- Once per combat, when you're struck for more than 20 damage: immediately gain +1 BT and refresh all active mutations
- Lasts until the end of combat or you fall below 25% HP |

warrior.supplement.brute-knuckles.name: Brute Knuckles
warrior.supplement.brute-knuckles.effect: Your unarmed strike damage die becomes 1d10. On an unarmed critical hit, the target makes a Strength save; on failure it drops one non-attuned held item of its choice.

source.originalText: | Brute Knuckles | Unarmed strikes deal 1d10 and apply Disarm on crit |

warrior.supplement.splinter-bone-fangs.name: Splinter Bone Fangs
warrior.supplement.splinter-bone-fangs.rangeAndTarget: Creature critically hit by your melee attack
warrior.supplement.splinter-bone-fangs.frequency: At most once per target per turn
warrior.supplement.splinter-bone-fangs.effect: A melee critical applies Bleed. The target takes 1d4 physical damage at the start of each of its next 2 turns. Reapplication refreshes rather than stacks.

source.originalText: | Splinter Bone Fangs | Melee crits cause 1d4 bleed for 2 rounds |

warrior.supplement.lashing-ligaments.name: Lashing Ligaments
warrior.supplement.lashing-ligaments.effect: For one melee attack on your turn, increase your reach by 5 feet. Using the extended reach does not itself provoke opportunity attacks.

source.originalText: | Lashing Ligaments | Gain +5 ft melee reach once per turn (doesn't provoke AoO) |

warrior.supplement.jaw-clench-node.name: Jaw Clench Node
warrior.supplement.jaw-clench-node.duration: Until end of your next regular turn
warrior.supplement.jaw-clench-node.effect: After you score a critical hit, gain +1 on attack rolls and +2 on Intimidation checks until the end of your next regular turn.

source.originalText: | Jaw Clench Node | Gain +1 to hit and +2 to Intimidation for 1 round after crit |

warrior.supplement.shoulder-spike-cluste.name: Shoulder Spike Cluster
warrior.supplement.shoulder-spike-cluste.rangeAndTarget: Creature grappling you or grappled by you
warrior.supplement.shoulder-spike-cluste.effect: When a grapple is established or maintained against you, or you successfully establish a grapple, the other creature takes 1d6 piercing damage.

source.originalText: | Shoulder Spike Cluster | When grappling or being grappled, attacker takes 1d6 damage |

warrior.supplement.shock-muscle-weave.name: Shock Muscle Weave
warrior.supplement.shock-muscle-weave.effect: When you take the ordinary Attack action, make one additional melee weapon attack. This additional attack is not a new Action and cannot itself grant another attack. It does not apply to card techniques unless they explicitly use the ordinary Attack action.

source.originalText: | Shock Muscle Weave | Gain +1 attack per turn (stacks with extra attacks, but only melee) |

warrior.supplement.razorbone-growths.name: Razorbone Growths
warrior.supplement.razorbone-growths.effect: Your melee attacks ignore 1 point of flat DR. Resistance and immunity are unaffected.

source.originalText: | Razorbone Growths | All melee attacks ignore 1 point of DR |

warrior.supplement.echo-knuckles.name: Echo Knuckles
warrior.supplement.echo-knuckles.effect: After you hit with a melee attack, make one offhand slam against the same target using your Warrior technique attack. On hit deal 1d8+M bludgeoning damage. This is a free attack, cannot trigger Echo Knuckles again and cannot grant another free attack.

source.originalText: | Echo Knuckles | Once per round, after hitting, make a free offhand slam (1d8) |

warrior.supplement.adrenal-backlash-core.name: Adrenal Backlash Core
warrior.supplement.adrenal-backlash-core.duration: Until end of your next regular turn
warrior.supplement.adrenal-backlash-core.effect: After you take damage, empower your next melee hit before the end of your next regular turn to deal +2d6 damage of the weapon's normal type. A new trigger refreshes but does not stack.

source.originalText: | Adrenal Backlash Core | When you take damage, your next melee hit deals +2d6 |

warrior.supplement.warpgrip-talons.name: Warpgrip Talons
warrior.supplement.warpgrip-talons.rangeAndTarget: Creature critically hit by your melee attack
warrior.supplement.warpgrip-talons.frequency: At most once per target per turn
warrior.supplement.warpgrip-talons.effect: A melee critical applies Weakened for 2 rounds. While Weakened, the target deals 1 less damage with each weapon or natural-weapon hit, minimum 0. Reapplication refreshes rather than stacks.

source.originalText: | Warpgrip Talons | Melee attacks apply Weakened on crit (–1 damage from target for 2 rounds) |

warrior.supplement.butcherform-chassis.name: Butcherform Chassis
warrior.supplement.butcherform-chassis.duration: 3 rounds or until below one-quarter maximum HP
warrior.supplement.butcherform-chassis.effect: When you take the ordinary Attack action, make one additional melee attack beyond other Extra Attack effects, respecting the one-additional-full-Action guard because this is part of the same Action. Your melee criticals add one extra weapon damage die beyond normal critical dice, not triple total damage. Once per round when you personally kill a meaningful hostile with a melee attack, restore one consumed prepared serum dose, never above reserve capacity.
warrior.supplement.butcherform-chassis.prerequisite: Warrior 15; Apex Combat; maximum one Apex equipped

source.originalText:
| Butcherform Chassis | While active:
- Gain +2 attacks per round
- Crits deal triple damage
- Melee kills instantly refresh 1 serum or 1 mutation use
- Lasts for 3 rounds or until you're below 25% HP |

warrior.supplement.ink-slick-glands.name: Ink-Slick Glands
warrior.supplement.ink-slick-glands.effect: Create opaque black mist. Creatures outside the cloud cannot see through it; ranged attacks passing through the cloud have disadvantage. Wind or an equivalent dispersal effect may end it early.

source.originalText: | Ink-Slick Glands | Once per rest, exude a cloud of black mist (3x3, blocks LoS, causes Disadvantage on ranged attacks) |

warrior.supplement.pulsing-vein-spiral.name: Pulsing Vein Spiral
warrior.supplement.pulsing-vein-spiral.effect: Gain +2 on Intimidation checks. Enemies within 5 feet take -1 on morale checks or the campaign's equivalent morale roll; this does not alter attack rolls or saving throws.

source.originalText: | Pulsing Vein Spiral | Gain +2 to Intimidation and cause –1 morale on adjacent enemies |

warrior.supplement.tremor-claws.name: Tremor Claws
warrior.supplement.tremor-claws.rangeAndTarget: Creature critically hit by your melee attack
warrior.supplement.tremor-claws.frequency: At most once per target per turn
warrior.supplement.tremor-claws.effect: After a melee critical, the target makes a Strength save. On failure it falls Prone.

source.originalText: | Tremor Claws | Your melee crits force target to make STR save or fall prone |

warrior.supplement.rib-lash-tendrils.name: Rib Lash Tendrils
warrior.supplement.rib-lash-tendrils.effect: When a creature damages you with a melee attack, it takes 1d4 psychic damage. This retaliation cannot trigger itself or other retaliation loops.

source.originalText: | Rib Lash Tendrils | When you are hit in melee, deal 1d4 retaliatory psychic damage |

warrior.supplement.bone-lure-growth.name: Bone Lure Growth
warrior.supplement.bone-lure-growth.effect: The target makes a Wisdom save. On failure it must use up to 15 feet of its available movement to move toward you by the safest path. This movement cannot force it into obviously lethal terrain and never consumes its Action.

source.originalText: | Bone Lure Growth | Once per encounter, force 1 enemy within 4 tiles to move toward you (WIS save negates) |

warrior.supplement.throat-split-maw.name: Throat Split Maw
warrior.supplement.throat-split-maw.duration: Until end of target's next turn
warrior.supplement.throat-split-maw.effect: You gain a bite attack dealing 1d8+M piercing damage. When the bite hits a creature capable of casting spells, it makes a Constitution save; on failure it is Silenced until the end of its next turn.

source.originalText: | Throat Split Maw | Your bite attack silences casters for 1 round on hit |

warrior.supplement.viral-core-sacs.name: Viral Core Sacs
warrior.supplement.viral-core-sacs.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
warrior.supplement.viral-core-sacs.effect: When you activate a serum, enemies within 10 feet make Constitution saves. On failure they have disadvantage on their next saving throw before the start of your next regular turn.

source.originalText: | Viral Core Sacs | When using a serum, release a 2x2 AoE that causes Disadvantage on saves for 1 round |

warrior.supplement.scythebone-spikes.name: Scythebone Spikes
warrior.supplement.scythebone-spikes.rangeAndTarget: Your unarmed strike target and one different adjacent creature
warrior.supplement.scythebone-spikes.effect: When an unarmed strike hits, choose one different enemy within 5 feet of the original target. If the same attack roll would hit that enemy's AC, it takes damage equal to the unarmed strike's base damage die without modifiers. This cleave is not another attack and triggers no on-hit effects.

source.originalText: | Scythebone Spikes | Your unarmed strikes gain cleave (hit 2 adjacent targets) |

warrior.supplement.carrion-signal-gland.name: Carrion Signal Gland
warrior.supplement.carrion-signal-gland.rangeAndTarget: Creature that hits you in melee
warrior.supplement.carrion-signal-gland.duration: Until end of target's next turn
warrior.supplement.carrion-signal-gland.effect: The attacker makes a Wisdom save. On failure it becomes Shaken, taking -1 on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

source.originalText: | Carrion Signal Gland | Enemies who hit you in melee must make WIS save or become Shaken |

warrior.supplement.wailing-eye-cluster.name: Wailing Eye Cluster
warrior.supplement.wailing-eye-cluster.duration: Until end of target's next turn
warrior.supplement.wailing-eye-cluster.effect: Enemies make Wisdom saves. On failure they become Disoriented: at the start of their next turn they cannot take Reactions and their first 5 feet of movement must be in a random legal horizontal direction determined by the Director. They otherwise keep their normal Action and movement.

source.originalText: | Wailing Eye Cluster | As a bonus action 1/rest, emit a psychic scream: enemies within 3 tiles must save or become Disoriented (random movement) |

warrior.supplement.voidbirth-shell.name: Voidbirth Shell
warrior.supplement.voidbirth-shell.effect: You may move through enemy spaces and nonmagical difficult terrain without extra cost but cannot end inside a creature or solid object. Enemies within 15 feet take -1 on attack rolls and morale. At the end of each of your turns create one 1-HP clone in an adjacent legal space, maximum 2 clones. A clone cannot attack or block movement; when destroyed it explodes, creatures within 5 feet make Dexterity saves taking 2d6 psychic on failure or half on success. Clones grant no resources, corpses, XP or BT.
warrior.supplement.voidbirth-shell.prerequisite: Warrior 15; Apex Aberrant; maximum one Apex equipped

source.originalText:
| Voidbirth Shell | While active:
- Gain Ethereal Movement (ignore terrain, move through enemies)
- Enemies within 3 tiles have –2 morale and suffer Weakened
- Each turn, summon 1 temporary clone (1 HP, explodes on death for 2d6 psychic)
- Lasts 3 rounds or until all clones are expended |

completeOriginalObject.effect: Each time you're hit while mutated, gain +1 BT

fixtures.completeOperativeProcedure: NEW require Warrior8 and equipped/active Ossified Core. Its existing extra-critical-dice prevention is the qualifying critical-protection state; the feat does not declare every critical hit a normal hit or prevent critical-triggered riders. Adopt the counterpart scope: halve only bonus damage explicitly identified by an actual source as Sneak Attack or equivalent precision damage. A critical, poison, elemental infusion, spell rider or ordinary ability modifier is not automatically precision. NEW this halving is a source-specific precision resistance layer: halve each typed precision component once, rounding down; an existing same-type damage resistance also covering that component does not halve it again. Other nonprecision damage remains subject to its own ordinary defenses; vulnerability/immunity and fixed reduction use current damage ordering. If mixed precision types have already been separated, apply their own immunity/resistance once each; do not halve the entire weapon packet because one part is precision. Ossified's separate post-resistance piercing−2 applies once by its own event contract. Benefits stop when Ossified is not active. No new resistance to every critical or all physical damage.

fixtures.completeOperativeProcedure: NEW require Warrior4 and two actual Combat mutations equipped and active at the trigger. Once per numbered round, after your personal direct melee attack reduces an independent meaningful hostile from positiveHP to0, gain+10ft to each existing usable Speed mode and one+1 entitlement on your next melee attack roll, both ending at the end of your next future original regular turn. This intentionally selects the counterpart zeroHP trigger rather than requiring actual death; resolve floors/knockout/death replacements first. The trigger grants no attack or fullAction. Copies, owned companion damage, ongoing ticks, captives, harmless targets and recycled bodies do not qualify. Modes derived from another Speed include this bonus once, not twice; previously spent movement remains spent. The attack entitlement consumes on the next legal melee attack roll, hit or miss; a save-only melee effect does not consume it. Same-family new trigger may refresh an unexpired record under the once-round cap but never gives+20ft or queued+1s. It ends if required equipped or active mutation eligibility is lost, even before its deadline. Encounter transitions do not extend or refresh either benefit.

fixtures.completeOperativeProcedure: NEW require Warrior8 and three actual Vital mutations equipped for acquisition; the benefit operates only while at least three distinct Vital mutations are actually active. No feat adds slots or active limits: the Warrior must have actual unlocked slots and an expressly acquired temporary active-count exception where needed. A Warrior8 normally cannot equip three mutations, so the printed level is a minimum rather than proof of present eligibility. Selected doctrine is the counterpart precise protection: opponents receive no advantage solely from a source explicitly granting advantage for flanking you. Reviewed ordinary combat has no global flanking advantage; this feat does not invent one. Independent unseen/Restrained/other advantage survives. It does not erase nearby bodies, ally assistance, legal target geometry, Tactical Flanker's separately proposed damage die, attacks or cover. When any required active state ends/suppresses, protection immediately stops; restoration within existing durations can restore protection without new actions or resources. No numericalAC/DR or immunity to all positioning effects.
